name: Comic Square
blurb: Thailand's largest doujinshi convention: a fan-comic and original-creator circle market at Union Mall, Bangkok, now in its 10th year.

editions.evidence: Info page: 'March 13-14, 2027 (SAT&SUN) AM11.00-PM6.00 Hr. at Union Hall 1-2, Fl.F6, Union Mall'; About page tagline: 'COMIC SQUARE 10 March 13-14, 2027, Union Hall 1-2, Union Mall, Bangkok, THAILAND'

notes: This is Comic Square 10 (CQ10), the 10th-anniversary edition, 2,300+ 'SPs' (doujin circle spaces). Organizer confirmed from the about page footer: '©2027 Anitime, COMIC SQUARE Staffs'. No guest program: the nav only has About Us/Information/Floorplan/For Visitor/For Circle — it is a doujinshi circle market (fan/original-creator tables), which the rules treat the same as artist-alley/vendor tables, so guests is 'none' rather than an unannounced lineup. Cover uses the homepage's 'CQ10_KV_A3-HD' key visual, credited elsewhere on the site to artist LavyPlus.
